patient._comment: 'patient' is info about the patient: personal, clinical, vitals are shown on the patient card during the game; diagnosis is used for potential 'patient review' card.

clinical.quoteLong: I was SO close to landing the kickflip. My wrist made a weird bendy crunch and now it hurts to twist it. ...Can I still skate this weekend?
clinical.presentationShort: 9yo M — FOOSH off a skateboard. Focal dorsal distal-forearm tenderness, subtle dorsal bump, NV intact, moving fingers.
clinical.presentationLong: 9-year-old male, fell onto an outstretched hand off a skateboard, focal tenderness with a subtle dorsal angulation over the distal forearm, neurovascularly intact and moving all fingers.

diagnosis.disposition: Fast Track → wrist X-ray, splint, ortho follow-up; discharge with return precautions.
diagnosis.why: Classic FOOSH buckle fracture — stable, one X-ray + splint. Back on the board in a few weeks. 🛹

answer._comment: 'answer' is answer for the game scoring.

aiImageGeneration._comment: 'aiImageGeneration' is info for AI to generate the image of the patient. Most images were done with openAI gpt-image-1 using an API, not the app, in July 2026. Look for some python scripts that are used to create these images. Be sure that the anchor-image is available and is provided to the AI - otherwise the images will not be consistent.
